title: Route a freshness budget
description: Select a consumer decision, execution mode, and publication interval. The model exposes the latency path and operating cost rather than treating streaming as automatically better.

scenarios.label: Daily training snapshot
scenarios.detail: A ranking model retrains after the prior UTC day is complete.

scenarios.label: Recommendation features
scenarios.detail: Recent engagement should influence the next browsing session.

scenarios.label: Payment fraud decision
scenarios.detail: A new risk signal must be visible before the next authorization.

modes.label: Bounded batch
modes.detail: Build one finite partition at each publication interval.

modes.label: Micro-batch
modes.detail: Build short bounded partitions from an ongoing source.

modes.label: Continuous stream
modes.detail: Update state continuously and publish on a short trigger.
